definitions.ask: Which bob config key should hold the plugin allowlist?
definitions.why: bob already says enabled for community-plugins.json; a second meaning invites confusion

choices.label: Ids live under `plugins: sync:`; no clash with the list VAULT column's enabled/disabled
Ids live under `plugins: enabled:`, matching the request; `enabled` then means two things

definitions.ask: Should `bob plugins list` and install-all show which repo plugins bob's config leaves out?
definitions.why: list is where users find ids to add; install-all shouldn't flag drift sync never touches
